name: Backrest
description: Web interface for restic backups, with schedules and easy restores

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Backrest's settings (config.json), with your repository passwords. Keep it private and back it up somewhere else too.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Your MOS storage at the same path, to back up and restore.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your other MOS disks, for repositories on a second disk.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Backrest web app, published on host as 6851

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BACKREST_DATA
variables.description: Where Backrest keeps its own data. Leave it as /data.

variables.name: BACKREST_CONFIG
variables.description: Backrest's settings file. Leave it as it is.

variables.name: XDG_CACHE_HOME
variables.description: Restic's cache folder. Leave it as /cache.

variables.name: TMPDIR
variables.description: Folder for temporary files during restores. Leave it as /tmp.
